[center][size=4]This add-on is simple enough![/size]
[/center]
I married Morris for the shiggles and ended up really liking him as a spouse. Then later on I got jumpscared by the vanilla children and decided it's time for me to learn how to mod and all that. Here's my first attempt at providing the modding community with some material! Let me know if I messed anything up.

Requirements are Lakoria's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552]'Babies Take After Spouse Plus New Toddler Hair and Clothes'[/url] mod and of course the basic SMAPI and Content Patcher. 

For Morris I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]. Not required, but those are what I use for more immersion! (If you like Morris' vanilla sprite but still want the seasonal outfits... There is also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975]Seasonal Outfits for SVE (Vanilla Style)[/url]!)

All you need to do is download the original mod, my files, and then copy/paste my files into the assets under the respective baby/male/female sub files.
